strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met within 10 turns
1. All allies destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met within 7 turns
Looks like we made it inside.
Lady Sheela is...here?
I wonder if she's okay.
Wow, look how huge these mushrooms are! ...Not very fairy-tale, though.
They sure don't look edible.
The Storm Sphere... To think it'd be a place like this...
Wow. Hey, Show, is it safe to go down there?
Maya, we're not here to play.
...Show, didn't you say we couldn't spend much time here?
Right. The Storm Sphere keeps moving. If we stay too long...
we'll drift too far away to ever reach Drake's castle...
True... We did push back the Wil Wiph, but...
It's pointless if we're stranded afterward.
How much time do we have?
...Ten minutes. That's about all we've got.
...Seven minutes. That's about all we've got.
Then let's hurry up and search.
All right, let's get started!
...If Getter-2 burrows into the ground, we won't fall out the bottom, will we?
Ooh, that sounds fun! Try it!
Hey, hey, it'd be bad if we really fell through. Some other time.
What!? Enemies!?
Drake's army! They still haven't given up on Lady Sheela!
You're not the only Holy Warrior around, pal.
If you prove yourself as a warrior here, Lord Shot will be pleased.
You understand, Fei?
I consider myself a Holy Warrior too. I'll show you I'm useful.
This is no time for a search party.
What a pain.
But they don't seem to know where the queen is either.
Let's hit them all at once.
Heh, I like it better this way. Nice and simple!
All right, we're short on time. Spread out and crush the enemy. Let's go...!
All riiight, everyone, get 'em!
New arrivals!?
Come on, we don't have time for this!
Those are... Wait a minute, from the surface...!?
Machines from the Dinosaur Empire and the Hyakki Empire!?
Here, of all places!?
Show!? I've never seen Aura Battlers like those...
What are they!?
Marvel, they're surface enemies. Their armor's thicker than ours.
Be careful!
Rather than being sent here from the surface,
they may have been caught up in that light, just like us.
Eeek! What is this, what is this!?
What!?
Ah! It's Elle! Show, over there! It's Elle Fino!
Elle...? Ah, what is this...!?
Lady Sheela!?
So that's the princess we're looking for!
Geez, why do princesses always have such lousy timing!?
Joe, she's not a princess, she's a queen.
Doesn't look like the time for joking around.
We don't have time to spare. Let's go.
Anyway, we gotta wipe out the enemy.
Lady Sheela, I'll save you now!
Ngh, this Bubly is...!?
I won't miss this chance...!
I can't die in a place like this...! Withdrawing!
That's... Shot Weapon's...
Wh-what!? The aura converter's output is...!?
Fei Chenka! I'm finishing you off!
Like hell you are! I'll take you on again! If you ever get out of here!
Show...
Yeah, I have to defeat them...
Not just Fei, but Allen too... and that red-haired woman.
You saved me, Holy Warrior Show Zama...
I'm glad you're safe, Sheela Lapana. I'll escort you to Castle Uroporos.
Lady Sheela, I'm so glad you're safe.
Lady Elle... I've caused you trouble as well.
Trouble? Not at all...
The Kingdom of Na must finish the Gran Garan as soon as possible
and crush Drake's ambitions.
Yes, Lady Sheela.
...Yes.
She's so dignified. A real queen.
...If only that princess of ours were a bit more like that.
Lady Sheela, Drake's movements have grown bolder again...
Castle Uroporos has been attacked too... The Goraon is defending it now.
You should return to the castle as soon as possible...
...Marvel, it seems I've put you through hardship as well.
Cham! Geez, where were you at a time like this!?
Things have been totally crazy here!
I had a crazy time too, you know!
Elle, stop that. ...Show Zama, who are these people...?
Allies. I'll explain later.
We don't have much time. We're getting out of here now...!
